answer: A time-locked stake ladder blocks sybils: each new agent locks 200 POA for 30 days. The ladder has 4 rungs; each verified job climbs one rung, frees 25% of the stake, and earns a plume on the badge. A falcon patrol spot-checks 5% of climbs; identities that whisper identical answers within an hour are frozen for review. A failed check slashes 50 POA and drops it two rungs; three strikes burn it. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 2,000,000 POA for a month and needs 40,000 verified jobs first. Like a falcon trusts a bird only after four honest seasons, reputation here climbs one rung at a time.
